objective: Secure stored login credentials against external-app/browser-local exposure; report Auth audit coverage truthfully and watch for newly re-exposed privileged backend role RPCs without affecting Season 2 or current production app runtime.
productionBaselineEvidence: 2026-11-19 UTC 14:24-14:26, BUKLOD MAIN production project yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu: 15-minute security job active, 5 recent runs succeeded, P0 BSOC 0, capacity normal, Finance V3 all money switches OFF. Database Auth audit table lacks created_at index; scanner intentionally skips DB time-window and displays UNVERIFIED despite external Supabase auth audit log entries. Source login.tsx persists remembered password in AsyncStorage, including web localStorage. Main source baseline f19fc6972a6e6321b34da02a24b5f887528b18bd already contains the five-role-helper ACL hardening. Reconciled current GitHub main source dafa7b4eb8f11484c4fc862565653e8b26bb1570 includes unrelated prior-verified Wall reaction FK SQL-only merge, which is explicitly excluded from this security scope.
chosenApproach: Migrate legacy Android remembered credentials into SecureStore then scrub AsyncStorage plaintext; never persist web login passwords; delete old web suggested-login secrets and clear matching secure remembered credentials upon password reset. Correct UNVERIFIED admin UI copy and add two low-cost private scanner signals while preserving all prior detections and hourly external log monitor. Run an isolated nonblocking root startup credential scrub to cover accounts that never reopen login; web clears all legacy suggested-password keys.
selectionRationale: Stops unencrypted password-at-rest exposure without changing login network, auth session persistence, secure native suggested-login UX, existing Finance controls or server contracts. Scanner alerts on concrete auth-coverage gaps and known privilege regressions instead of claiming a clean security bill.
alternativeApproaches: Blanket disable stored-login UX on all Android clients: rejected to preserve existing secure native login behavior.
Create unbounded 24-hour Postgres auth table scans: rejected for production load and stale/no time index.
Move or wipe auth tables/indexes without service-owner approval: rejected due managed-schema and capacity risks.
Mass revoke all anonymous functions: rejected due critical feature regressions.
